senses.gloss:
f. (-णी)
1 Torn or ragged clothes.
2 A sack.
3 The measure of a Droṇa.
E.
गुण to reckon, affixes अच् and ङीष्, the deriv. irr.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
A person with a prominent navel.
m. (-ण्डः)
A man of a low tribe, a mountaineer, especially inhabiting the eastern portion of the Vindhya range, between the Nerbudda and Kṛṣṇa, giving name to the province of Gondwana.
2 A prominent navel, or a lump of flesh on the navel, &c.
E.
गुडि to enclose, &c. अच् aff.
